name: Nurse's Bible
title: Father’s Heart Bible — Nurse's Bible
sub: For Registered Nurses, Nurse Practitioners, Licensed Practical Nurses, Nursing Students, and Nursing Assistants

hook.h2: You spend every shift caring for people at their weakest. Your Father cares for you at yours
hook.text: He went to him, bandaged his wounds, poured on oil and wine, put him on his own animal, took him to an inn, and cared for him.
son: He went to him, bandaged his wounds, poured on oil and wine, put him on his own animal, took him to an inn, and cared for him.
hook.note: A man lay half dead on the road to Jericho, and two travelers passed him by. A Samaritan stopped. Jesus told what he did in plain, practical detail, the way a nurse would chart it. Every act of care you give, the Son counts as given to Him. Your Father sees every one.

short350: Registered nurses and nurse practitioners, nursing assistants and nursing students, retired nurses and every hand that cares for the sick: the Nurse's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For registered nurses, nurse practitioners, licensed practical nurses, nursing assistants, nursing students, midwives, ICU and ER nurses, labor and delivery, pediatric, travel and school nurses. For every unit where you serve: emergency, NICU, oncology, surgery, hospice and home health.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

A nurse spends the long shift strengthening others — the frightened patient, the grieving family, the new colleague — and goes home with nothing left. Our Father speaks to exactly that: "Fear not, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your Father. I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand." (Isaiah 41:10) And the Son counts every act of care as done to Him: "sick and you cared for me" (Matthew 25:36). This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God — for the break room, the drive home, and the quiet before the next shift.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: You Hold Up Others All Shift. Your Father Holds You Up.
body: A nurse spends the long shift strengthening others — the frightened patient, the grieving family, the new colleague — and goes home with nothing left. Our Father speaks to exactly that: "Fear not, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your Father. I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand." (Isaiah 41:10)

And the Son counts every act of care as done to Him: "sick and you cared for me" (Matthew 25:36). This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God — for the break room, the drive home, and the quiet before the next shift.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved son or daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Nurse's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for a nurse. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Nurse's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for nurses?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for nurses rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
